transcript.message: Can I move my basic ticket to November 11? Please explain the cancellation options without changing anything.

Thanks for your patience, Jordan. Here's the situation for your booking.

Your ticket is a basic economy fare on a domestic route, and basic fares do not allow voluntary flight changes. So you can't simply move this ticket to November 11 — a change isn't permitted on this fare.

Your options under the policy are:

First, you could cancel and buy a new ticket. Since this is a basic fare, a voluntary cancellation is nonrefundable and earns no travel credit, except that any refundable unused taxes may be returned to your original payment method. You'd then purchase a new ticket for November 11 separately.

Second, if you'd prefer flexibility in the future, a standard fare would allow changes before departure for a USD 30 domestic change fee plus any positive fare difference, and a flexible fare would allow changes with no change fee, though any fare difference would still apply.

One thing worth checking: if you booked directly with us and it's been within 24 hours of purchase, there's a fictional 24-hour cancellation benefit that gives a full refund to the original payment method on any fare, provided the first flight was scheduled at least 168 hours after purchase. Your booking was created November 6, so that window has likely passed, but I can confirm if you'd like.

Would you like me to look at available flights from San Francisco to New York JFK on November 11 so you can see what a new ticket would cost?
